description_en: Modifies host account information, including the name, password, and private key of a host account
description_zh: 修改主机账户信息，支持修改主机账户的名称、密码和私钥信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance where the host account to modify resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where the host account to query resides.

For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。

地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host account to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改的主机账户ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the host account. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的主机账户名称，最多支持128字符
parameters.name: host_account_name

parameters.help_en: The new password of the host account
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的主机账户密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.example:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
......
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en:
The new private key of the host account. The private key is a Base64-encoded string.

This parameter takes effect only when the protocol of the host account is SSH. If the protocol is RDP, you do not need to configure this parameter. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204391.html operation to query the protocol used by the host account. You can configure both a password and a private key for the host account. When connecting to an asset, the bastion host preferentially uses the private key
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的主机账户私钥，私钥为使用Base64编码后的字符串。

主机账户协议为SSH时，该参数生效。主机账户协议为RDP时，无需配置该参数。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204391.html接口查询主机账户使用的协议。支持同时为主机账户配置密码和私钥。在连接资产时，堡垒机会优先使用私钥进行连接
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
The new passphrase of the private key for the host account.

This parameter takes effect only when the protocol of the host account is SSH. If the protocol is RDP, you do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后的主机账户的私钥口令。

主机账户协议为SSH时，该参数生效。主机账户协议为RDP时，无需配置该参数
parameters.name: pass_phrase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shared key for the host.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
主机共享密钥ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The privilege type of the account. Valid values:
Privileged: privileged account.
Normal: standard account.
Only supported in V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户权限类型，取值：
Privileged：特权账户
Normal：普通账户
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: privilege_type

parameters.help_en:
The password rotation mode of the account. Valid values:
Privileged: uses a privileged account to rotate the password.
Self: does not use a privileged account to rotate the password.
Only supported in V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户改密模式，取值：
Privileged：使用特权账户改密
Self：不使用特权账户改密
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: rotation_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to which the host of the host account belongs
parameters.help_zh: 主机账户所在主机所属的项目ID
parameters.name: project_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
